algo.label: Balancing algorithm
algo.roundRobinTradeoff: Simple and fair, but ignores how busy a replica is.
algo.leastConnTradeoff: Evens out load, slightly more bookkeeping per request.
algo.ipHashUse: You need clients to stay put without cookies.
algo.ipHashTradeoff: Clients behind one proxy or CDN all land on one replica.
algo.clientIpHashUse: You want IP stickiness behind a CDN or proxy.
algo.clientIpHashTradeoff: Needs APP_INGRESS_TRUSTED_PROXIES, else it matches IP hash.
algo.uriHashTradeoff: Hot paths can overload one replica.
algo.cookieTradeoff: Pins a browser to one replica, so uneven load is possible.
algo.weightedUse: Canaries or replicas of different sizes.
algo.weightedTradeoff: You maintain the weights by hand.

bar.confirmHint: These take effect on live traffic right away.

configure.cookieNameInfo: The cookie that pins a browser to one replica.

health.activeInfo: Probe every replica on an interval and stop sending traffic to one that fails.
health.pathInfo: The URL probed on each replica. It should return quickly and only depend on the app itself.
health.statusInfo: The HTTP status that counts as a pass. Blank accepts any 2xx or 3xx.
health.intervalInfo: How often each replica is probed.
health.timeoutInfo: How long to wait for a reply. Must be shorter than the interval.
health.failsInfo: Consecutive failed probes before a replica leaves the pool.
health.passesInfo: Consecutive passing probes before a replica rejoins the pool.
health.passiveInfo: Watch real requests. A replica that keeps failing them is skipped for a while, faster than waiting for the next probe.
health.maxFailsInfo: Failed requests within the window that trigger a skip.
health.skipForInfo: How long a failing replica is skipped, and the window failures are counted in.

resilience.retriesInfo: Retry a failed request on another replica before giving up. Turn off for streams that cannot be replayed.
resilience.retryCountInfo: Extra attempts after the first. 0 to 10.
resilience.giveUpInfo: Total time spent retrying one request.
resilience.requestTimeoutInfo: How long to wait for a replica to start answering before failing the request.
resilience.drainInfo: How long open connections may finish when a replica is replaced during a deploy.
resilience.rateInfo: Cap requests per client address. Clients above the limit get a 429 response.
resilience.rpsInfo: Sustained rate allowed for each client address.
resilience.burstInfo: Extra requests allowed in a short spike.
resilience.tlsInfo: Speak HTTPS to the replicas instead of plain HTTP.
resilience.serverNameInfo: Name the replicas certificate must match.
resilience.skipVerifyInfo: Accept any certificate. Only for testing: it removes protection against impersonation.

weights.title: Traffic split
weights.aboutBody: Weights follow replica index. A replica with weight 3 gets three times the traffic of one with weight 1.
weights.slowStartInfo: A new replica ramps from zero up to its weight over this time instead of taking its full share at once.

topology.howToReadBody: Line density shows each replica's share of open connections. Faster motion means lower latency. Shapes and labels show health: check circle is healthy, triangle is draining, square is down.
topology.diagram: Traffic from clients through the proxy to {{total}} upstreams, {{healthy}} healthy
topology.allDown: Nothing is passing checks. Requests may fail until a replica recovers.
